title: IVG 2400 Reload Blue Raspberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pod Kit, these IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pods provide a convenient way to refresh your device with a bold and refreshing berry flavour. Each pack contains two individual 2ml prefilled pods, delivering up to 2400 puffs per kit (depending on personal usage) while ensuring smooth and consistent vapour production. The Blue Raspberry Ice Edition blends the sweet and tangy notes of Blue Raspberry with a cooling menthol exhale, creating a well-balanced fruit flavour with a crisp finish. Whether you enjoy fruity vapes with an icy edge or a bold berry profile, this flavour delivers a satisfying all-day vape. Swapping pods is effortless—just replace an empty pod with a fresh one and continue enjoying your vape. Whether you're looking for an easy way to keep your device performing at its best or a simple alternative to disposables, these pods provide a convenient and mess-free vaping solution.
